notes: Phonon-2 for LiteRT (litert-community/Phonon-2): FermionResearch/Phonon-2 (revision 3e6ab3a8, CC-BY-4.0) keeps the architecture and tokenizer of nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (a 24-layer encoder and a TDT decoder) and stores the encoder's linear weights as five values per output row and the other large weights as 6-bit tables; these files expand them to float16 (the f16 forms, for the GPU and the NPU) or int8 (the i8 forms, for the CPU, quantized with ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0), exported with litert-torch 0.9.4 into raw LiteRT graphs: an encoder per window length (the first release: three files, 10 / 20 / 30 s; the update: one file with the seven signatures enc5 / enc7.5 / enc10 / enc15 / enc20 / enc25 / enc30, in three forms: f16, f16 compiled ahead of time for the SM8850, i8; a window runs in the smallest length that holds it, with a valid-length mel mask), a log-mel graph per window length and one int8 TDT decoder. Text = the token ids decoded with the repo's tokenizer.json (repeated ids kept). Accuracy is WER against reference P_ii (transformers 5.20.2 ParakeetForTDT in float32 with the weights read out of Phonon-2's container, the same windows with a valid-length mask, the same greedy TDT decoding), with both the open-asr-leaderboard formula (L) and jiwer (J); sets from hf-audio/open-asr-leaderboard @ de79e57a. Pixel 11 Pro: the runs the card reads that load this file, and nothing else — GPU: S4 f6gpu_s4_b1, S4 f6gpu_s4_b2. Runners: ultra_asr_runner_p7. Not records: the other --pipeline setting of each A/B pair (the card quotes its RTF), the earlier runs of the same forms, the two-accelerator forms (not published), the card's usage-block runs and the Mac rows.
